description: Auditable natural-language dialogue planning, contextual affect scoring, and 6-stage transparent URI process pipeline.

nl.parse.description: Step 1: Parse NL instruction, trust_level preset, and author_brief into FictionRequest and canonical Action URI.

context.filter.description: Step 2: Filter visible dialogue history and compute baseline reader_proxy and character_expression_proxies.

candidates.generate.description: Step 3: Generate candidate dialogue lines from deterministic templates, SubLLM (subactor/subllm), or Ollama.

affect.score.description: Step 4: Score and rank candidate lines against target affect vector with contextual lexical rules and repetition penalty.

dsl.compile.description: Step 5: Compile affect-fiction 0.3 DSL and verify deterministic replay().

report.emit.description: Step 6: Emit CompositeExecutionReceipt, hash-chained event logs, and auditable execution report.

pipeline.run.description: Run the complete 6-stage transparent edialog pipeline and return proposal, step traces, receipt, logs, and reuse snippets.

run.description: Generic instruction execution endpoint for edialog (DOCK-DISP-001).

scene.analyze.description: Analyze emotional trajectory of an existing dialogue.

dsl.replay.description: Replay an affect-fiction 0.3 DSL plan and optionally append the winning turn to the scene.
